highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.154.0 previews the Skia m154 engine update with refreshed package documentation.
highlights_body: HarfBuzzSharp bindings now follow the bundled native source, including two small source-compatibility changes described below.

breaking.title: UnicodeCombiningClass.CCC133 renamed to CCC132
breaking.body: HarfBuzzSharp now uses HarfBuzz's corrected `CCC132` name for the value 132. Replace references to `UnicodeCombiningClass.CCC133` with `UnicodeCombiningClass.CCC132` and rebuild.

breaking.title: GlyphFlags.Defined removed
breaking.body: `GlyphFlags.Defined` was an aggregate mask rather than an independent option and is no longer exposed. Combine the concrete glyph flags your code requires when constructing a mask.

bullets.detail: The bundled renderer moves to Skia m154 and includes the latest upstream Chrome m154 fixes.

bullets.lead: Package XML documentation is available to consumers
bullets.detail: SkiaSharp packages now ship compiler-generated XML documentation alongside the managed assemblies, improving API documentation in supported tooling.

contributor_summaries.azchohfi: Improved the HarfBuzzSharp native build warning configuration

preview_summaries.v4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9: Preview 1 opens the 4.154 line with the Skia m154 engine update.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1 now generates its bindings from the HarfBuzz revision bundled by Skia. The refresh corrects the Unicode combining-class name and removes the aggregate GlyphFlags.Defined mask.

v4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9.headline: SkiaSharp 4.154.0 Preview 1 introduces the Skia m154 engine update.
v4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9.body: This preview starts the 4.154 release line with the current upstream renderer.
